messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `hosted-inference-prod` (PD-INC-3342). Trigger: 5xx rate > 10% over 2m. Priority: P1. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.

pagerduty-bot: Paging primary (maria) now. Call/SMS/Push. Attempts: 1/6.

maria: ack'd? I'm on a call, saw the push but DND on phone. Switching to laptop.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: page not acknowledged after 1 attempt. Escalating to secondary (akash) in 90s.

akash: saw the ping. my phone is showing carrier blocked for international sms for PD. trying web console.

akash: web console shows "acknowledge" button. clicking... acked — checking prod logs. :eyes:

maria: thanks. quick note — I was on scheduled maintenance window earlier, might have missed the first push.

kevin: from tracing, 5xxs concentrated on /v1/generate for model rwd-open-13b-quant with long context. Error pattern: OOM-ish kernel crash followed by 502 from runtime.

liz: any customer impact? dashboard shows spike in error rate for the hosted region us-west1, affecting roughly 12% of requests for that endpoint in last 3m. A subset of customers on new rollout flagged it.

akash: confirming — looks like a bad rollout: a quantized build was promoted to hosted via canary earlier, memory usage jumped. Reverting canary now.

maria: if we can revert to prior model snapshot quickly that's best. who can push rollback?

kevin: matt is offline. I can trigger a rollback job to previous model image (rwd-open-13b-quant:v42 -> v41). Run command:```
# rollback command
redwoodctl model rollback --service hosted-inference-prod --model rwd-open-13b-quant --to-version v41
```

kevin: kicked the job, watching deployment logs.

pagerduty-bot: Secondary (akash) acknowledged the alert. Escalation stopped.

incident-bot: Created incident room: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567 (incident-room).

liz: pinging ops to scale up fallback pool (dedicated-pool-1) so we can route traffic while rollback completes.

satish: I'm stepping in as manager on-call, joining bridge. Formatting update cadence: every 2m.

maria: rollback job shows rollout aborted at 15%. Need to drain two hosts manually that have the new binary. Logs: "cuda_mem_alloc failed" on host gpu-23 and gpu-27.

akash: I'm on ssh. draining gpu-23 now. command: `ssh gpu-23 sudo systemctl stop redwood-runtime && /opt/redwood/bin/evacuate-kv.sh`

maria: after draining, please confirm health check response for /health on those hosts.

kevin: health for gpu-23 -> 404 during drain (expected), then removed from LB. gpu-27 still showing kernel OOM messages. I'll reprovision.

incident-bot: PD escalation timer: next escalation to manager if unacked/unresolved in 10m. Current status: acknowledged by secondary, mitigation in progress.

liz: customer impact note for postmortem: 12% elevated errors, primary affected customers are sandbox and a couple of integration partners that were on canary routing. No billing impact reported yet.

satish: good triage. prioritize complete rollback and confirm 5xx rate under 1% before claiming mitigation.

kevin: rollback reached 100% on control plane, new routing policy applied to route new requests to v41. Observability shows latency stable and 5xx dropping.

akash: monitoring: 5xx rate down to 2% and trending down after re-route. still seeing a handful of OOMs from older machines — patching kernel mem alloc fallback.

maria: can we ramp the host count for dedicated-pool-1 by +2 to absorb traffic spikes?

liz: scaling requested, autoscaler will spin two instances; ETA ~120s.

kevin: scaled dedicated-pool-1 by 2, instances healthy. 5xx rate now 0.8% over the last 2m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-3342: status changed to "Mitigated" (ack still present). Will auto-resolve in 30m if no further alerts.

maria: reassigning followups: kevin to root cause (model binary/quantization memory footprint), akash to deploy safe canary gating, liz to customer comms. Satish to own postmortem review.

satish: agreed. please add a timeline to the postmortem and mark impacted customers. I'll take lead review tomorrow 10:00am PT.

akash: one note — PagerDuty escalation chain was noisy because primary's device was in DND and PD retried SMS which is blocked; can we add a secondary push path (mobile push -> slack DM fallback) to avoid SMS dependency?

maria: +1 on alternate path. Also can we tune the threshold to require 2m sustained >10% and cross-check with runtime OOM alarms before firing a P1? fewer false high-priority pages.

kevin: capturing action items in incident room. I'll paste quick logs and stack traces there.

liz: customer comm draft (internal): "We detected elevated errors for text generation endpoints for a subset of customers during a canary rollout of a quantized model. We reverted the rollout and traffic is back to normal. We will follow up with a detailed postmortem." :email:

incident-bot: PD-INC-3342: note added by akash: "Rollback completed, routing stable, scaling applied."

maria: closing loop here — thanks all for rapid response. we should run a retro for canary gating and PD flow next week. :thumbsup:

satish: thanks team. I'll schedule postmortem doc and maker notes."
